name: video-and-audio
description: Make or edit video and audio with Glif, from a text brief or from a reference image, video or audio file. Use when: "make a video", "video clip", "short-form video", "explainer video", "talking avatar", "lipsync", "dub this into Spanish", "GIF", "add captions", "trim or combine these clips", "animate this photo", "make this photo dance", "bullet time", "one continuous shot around this", "make a music video for my song", "drive this character with my video", "show this room renovated", "use this video's structure", "make music", "add fitting music to my video", "jingle", "voiceover", "narrate this", "text to speech", "sound effect", "UI sounds", "ambient loop", "split the vocals", "remove background noise". NOT for: still images (use images), or ads, product videos and app demo videos (use ads-and-promo).
